passives.name: It’s Checkmate!
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Regina always gains 10% increased Miss Chance, and deals greatly increased damage while she has Regina’s World. (Trigger Effect) When an enemy attack results in a miss, counterattacks the target and triggers Regina’s World 2 time(s). Damage dealt increases in proportion to the caster’s Critical Hit Chance. (Up to 50%)
